mapper.sql: a.id AS attempt_id,a.student_id,u.real_name AS student_name,u.identity_no, a.course_id,c.name AS course_name,a.attempt_no,a.score,a.total_score,a.started_at,a.submitted_at
FROM exam_attempt a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.student_id JOIN course c ON c.id=a.course_id

WHERE a.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND a.status='SUBMITTED'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_attempt newer WHERE newer.student_id=a.student_id AND newer.course_id=a.course_id AND newer.status='SUBMITTED' AND newer.attempt_no > a.attempt_no)
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_attempt WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND status='SUBMITTED'
